validation_results.failure: A long Disable branch let a reserve finish Juggler 3 after the workhorse fainted. The route then initiated Tamer 2 before its existing pair-level Center recovery, so the next live trainer battle began with a fainted lead.

diagnosis: The battle controller could legally continue Juggler 3 with a healthy reserve, but the chapter scheduled its first Center visit only after Tamer 2. That optimized two trainers into one recovery trip at the cost of violating the balanced-party invariant on held-out damage and Disable timing.
repair_direction: Return to the Fuchsia Center immediately after Juggler 3, prove full-party HP, status, and Surf PP recovery, then re-enter the Gym for Tamer 2 while retaining the later recovery boundaries.
